office.note: The booking is Nowhere. It is three days downriver. You will be back at Cra-Zi before dark. Reverse is unreliable. The safety valve is painted shut. Pick something to carry.

node.threatSalvage: {label} — {threat} to clear · ore if you leave it at {max} or under

log.deadpan: — delivered completely straight. He is not making a joke.
log.jokeOffTopic: Wrong stretch for that — it plays off-topic.
log.jokeStrong: It lands. You can feel the boat lighten.
log.jokeFair: Polite. A few of them got it.
log.jokeBad: That was the wrong room for that.
log.riskOverboard: Someone is now in the river. Briefly. Mostly.
log.steer: You put the helm over and open her up. The gauge eases. You say nothing at all.
log.steerSelling: The falls are not a channel. You keep her pointed downstream. The gauge eases. You are not parked.
log.wrench: You go below and keep the beast running. Something is always coming undone. Forty people watch you disappear.
log.bail: You hand out the buckets. Everyone bails. It looks exactly as bad as it is.
log.bailJump: Someone stands up. They are not holding a bucket. They are looking at the rail.
log.silence: The room notices you stopped talking.
log.boilerCrisis: The gauge is past the red and the valve is painted shut. The only fix is more throttle.
log.boilerCrisisFix: You open her up. Into whatever's ahead.
log.waterCrisis: She's taking it faster than you can pretend she isn't. Everyone's feet are wet.
log.unresolved: You do not clear {label}. The Ginny finds out first. The old girl takes a hit on the {side} side. You'll need to look at that.
log.pianoNote: The piano sounds a note. Perfect comic timing, no comic.
log.leopardGone: The crate has come open. The crate is empty. The crate was not empty nine seconds ago.
log.cleanSelling: You've sold it as hard as it can be sold.
log.fallsUnsold: Forty people paid for a legend. You spent the advertised falls on the boat.
log.clean: Clean water. Nobody noticed how close that was, which is the job.
log.fallsHigh: They rate the falls generously. They are lying, and they are lying for you.
log.fallsMid: They rate the falls honestly. That costs money.
log.fallsLow: One of them writes 'nine feet' in a notebook. You saw it happen.
log.nowhereHome: Crazy always gets closer. You will be back at Cra-Zi before the sign changes.
log.salvage: You come out with a crate of ore and a story about turning a boat that does not reverse.

card.rule: One action per beat. Patter spends the beat you would have used to steer. Silence drains the room.

branch.title: The chart
branch.sub: Surveyed once. By one man. Some years ago.

ducks.title: The Two Ducks
ducks.note: The fast route is to port and everyone knows it. The other route is between them, which is slower, and wrong, and you are going to say the thing.
ducks.open: Two ducks, one either side of the sandbar. The fast water is to port.
ducks.openGoose: Two ducks. And between them, standing in four inches of water with its neck out — a goose.
ducks.funnySetup: Two ducks, one either side — steer between them and you get a para—
ducks.funnyFail: It's a goose. There are three of them and one is a goose and there is no version of this joke that works.
ducks.funnyLand: It kills. It is not the bit you planned. It is worse. It kills.
ducks.funnyGroan: A groan travels the length of the boat. That's a win. That's what a groan is.
ducks.funnyCost: The slow route costs you. Pressure climbing.
ducks.fastAct: You take the fast water and say nothing. The ducks go by to port, unremarked.
ducks.fastAsk: Someone asks about the ducks. You've already passed them.

boulder.title: The boulder
boulder.note: I am conflicted on which direction to go. Left or right.
boulder.scrape: The rail finds the granite. There was a clean side. This was not it.
boulder.clear: Clear water. The other channel would not have been.

punchlines.text: The boulder is no longer conflicted.
I guess the boulder wasn't conflicted.

nowhere.passed: A board in the mud: NOWHERE — THREE DAYS. The face pointing home says the same. You have arrived. You have not.
nowhere.missed: The tributary ate the afternoon. Nowhere is still three days — from here, from there, from the mine.
nowhere.abort: You put her about. Nowhere will still be three days next week. The passengers have done the arithmetic.

settle.title: Welcome back to Cra-Zi
settle.note: You always arrive at Crazy. Nowhere never gets closer.

why.text: {refunds} of them want their money back. The room finished at {sat}.
Knight Falls went by and you did not sell it.
The boat had had enough. You never made Nowhere.
Wrong turn. Nowhere will still be three days next week.
You passed Nowhere. It is still three days. You are back at Crazy.
The Ginny will need work before she goes out again.

settle.leopard: The leopard is still out there.
